parameters.title: The bar's heading, usually a Text.
parameters.actions: Widgets after the title, such as buttons.
parameters.leading: A widget before the title; by default a back or menu button.
parameters.automaticallyImplyLeading: Whether to add that back or menu button when leading is null.
parameters.centerTitle: Whether the title sits in the middle.
parameters.bottom: A widget under the bar, usually a TabBar.
